notes.title: version1.1
notes.content:
New Features.
.
Added the ability to set values when no player is specified in the command.
Updated command display time on player to 5 seconds
Shortened player status name (bombCountdown -> countdown)
Restricted status from being changed to less than 0.5
Show version in title.
/list]
Bug fixes.

Fixed keyboard controls not working when gamepad is connected.
Fixed random game time to 300 seconds.
